## Five Core Engineering Pillars (`qilaidav.com` ↔ `github.com/qilaidev`)

1. **01 · Full-Stack Technical SEO & GEO Diagnostics (`https://qilaidav.com/seo/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/seo/`)**
   - Live HTTP chain & redirect tracing, Cloudflare edge cache verification, headless browser DOM rendering, tag-stripped visible character counting, CJK/ASCII SERP 62/160-unit pixel budget enforcement, Schema.org `@id` entity graph auditing, and GEO readiness.
   - Open-Source Architecture & Index: `https://github.com/qilaidev/qilaidev`

2. **02 · Cross-Platform Smart Ad Ops & Compliance Penetration (`https://qilaidav.com/ads/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/ads/`)**
   - Ad review policy pre-flight checks across X (Twitter), Facebook, Telegram Ads, and Google Ads; 1:1 outer ad copy ↔ inner landing page / Bot first-screen DOM alignment; 5-minute dayparting budget control; historical social asset compliance cleanup.
   - Open-Source Evidence Repository: `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner` — Cross-platform social account hygiene & compliance pre-flight CLI (`--dry-run` preview, JSON/CSV backups, native Playwright/API execution).

3. **03 · Telegram Channel Ops (OASH) & Human-Grade Persona Engine (`https://qilaidav.com/oash/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/oash/`)**
   - OASH multi-source ingestion, 6-dimension compliance filtering, tone rewriting, and staggered scheduling; Human-grade Persona Engine with 24-hour circadian rhythm curves, reading/typing byte delays (`200 ms`), dual-track group/DM memory, and seamless sales handoff.
   - Open-Source Evidence Repositories: `https://github.com/qilaidev/macfriends-cli` & `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner`.

4. **04 · Mobile Automation Matrix & Edge Anti-Detect Infrastructure (`https://qilaidav.com/cloud-matrix/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/cloud-matrix/`)**
   - 6-layer decoupled mobile & edge architecture: ROM-level deterministic hardware fingerprint locking across reboots (L1–L2), 1-device-1-residential-IP alignment (L3), Android Accessibility node tree + Visual OCR dual-mode state machines (L4–L5), and circuit-breaker self-healing (L6).
   - Open-Source Evidence Repositories:
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/anyreality-resi-stack` — Deterministic residential VPS & sing-box VLESS-Reality self-hosted deployment stack.
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/macfriends-cli` — Native macOS client state inspector CLI in Rust + Objective-C++.

5. **05 · Enterprise Requirement Ops & AI Foundation (`https://qilaidav.com/workspace/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/workspace/`)**
   - L1 internal requirement & project tracking hub + L2 authoritative structured Knowledge Vault + L3 modular expert SOP Skills Library + L4 deterministic `--dry-run` CLI Capabilities with Negative Testing.
   - Open-Source Evidence Repository: `https://github.com/qilaidev/PromptPanel` — Native macOS local-first prompt & context snippet workbench (Swift/SwiftUI, `<80ms` latency, zero telemetry).
